lines.line: I would like to know you better.
lines.reply: We can begin with a little time together. What would you like to know?
lines.refusal: I can talk with you, but knowing me better will not change my feelings.

lines.line: You have caught my eye. May I stay?
lines.reply: You may stay. I would like to see what caught your eye.
lines.refusal: You may stay as a neighbour. I do not want to give you false hope.

lines.line: I hoped we might talk again.
lines.reply: And here we are. I wondered whether you would come back.
lines.refusal: We can talk again. I need you to understand where I stand.

lines.line: There is something about you that draws me here.
lines.reply: Then stay and find out. I am curious about you too.
lines.refusal: I hear that you feel drawn to me. I must be honest about my own feelings.

lines.line: I find myself looking for you in the village.
lines.reply: I will look out for you as well. There are worse ways to begin a day.
lines.refusal: I would be sorry if looking for me kept you from finding someone willing.

lines.line: Will you walk with me a little?
lines.reply: A short walk would be welcome. Come alongside me.
lines.refusal: I can offer a friendly walk. I cannot offer courtship.

lines.line: I like the sound of your voice.
lines.reply: Then you will have to give me something worth talking about.
lines.refusal: I am glad my voice pleases you. Affection needs more than that.

lines.line: I am glad our paths crossed today.
lines.reply: I am glad too. It is a good day to meet someone.
lines.refusal: Our paths can cross without either of us promising more.

lines.line: I would like another moment of your company.
lines.reply: A moment, then. You have my attention.
lines.refusal: I can spare a moment of company, but I must speak plainly.

lines.line: May I sit beside you for a while?
lines.reply: There is room here. Sit, and tell me about yourself.
lines.refusal: You may sit here. Please do not mistake a welcome for a promise.

lines.line: I came hoping to see you.
lines.reply: You found me. I am pleased you made the effort.
lines.refusal: I am here, and I hear you. I need to tell you how I feel.

lines.line: I would like us to be more than strangers.
lines.reply: Let us learn each other’s ways, and see where that takes us.
lines.refusal: We need not be strangers. I cannot promise we will become lovers.

memoryReplies.family: There is more I can tell you about {name}. I am glad you want to listen.
memoryReplies.work: The {trade} work fills much of my day. It is good to have someone take an interest.
memoryReplies.news: You remembered the news: {news}. I am glad you listened.
memoryReplies.trait: {trait_reply} I am curious to learn your ways too.

memoryRefusals.family: I am glad you listened about {name}. I need you to hear my answer as well.
memoryRefusals.trait: You have noticed my {trait} side. I must be clear about my feelings.
memoryRefusals.work: It is kind of you to take an interest in my {trade} work. I must answer honestly.
memoryRefusals.news: I did want you to hear this: {news}. Sharing news was not a promise of courtship.

lines.line: I have been looking forward to seeing you again.
lines.reply: I hoped we would meet again today. I kept a place for you.
lines.refusal: I enjoy seeing you, but I must not let these visits promise more than I feel.

lines.line: The day feels better when we spend it together.
lines.reply: You have made my day lighter too. Stay a little longer.
lines.refusal: A pleasant day together is something I can share. I cannot offer more.

lines.line: I keep thinking of our talks.
lines.reply: I turn our talks over in my mind as well. Especially the quiet parts.
lines.refusal: I value our talks. I do not want you to read a promise into them.

lines.line: I am beginning to feel at home beside you.
lines.reply: I like that you can rest beside me. You need not put on a brave face.
lines.refusal: Feeling at home beside someone matters. I must be honest about what is possible.

lines.line: You are becoming someone I look for every day.
lines.reply: I look for you too. The village feels different when you are away.
lines.refusal: I know you look for me. I do not want you waiting for an answer that will change.

lines.line: I missed your company since we last spoke.
lines.reply: I missed you as well. Tell me how your day went.
lines.refusal: I hear that you missed me. I need to be clear about my feelings.

lines.line: Shall we find a quiet place together?
lines.reply: Yes, let us sit away from the bustle for a while.
lines.refusal: A quiet place will not change what I need to tell you.

lines.line: I like how easily we talk now.
lines.reply: We have learned how to listen to each other. I like that ease.
lines.refusal: I like being able to talk easily. That makes honesty all the more necessary.

lines.line: I want to make more time for you.
lines.reply: I can make time for you too. We both have lives to tend.
lines.refusal: Your time is precious. I do not want to take it under a false promise.

lines.line: I feel happier when you are near.
lines.reply: I am happier for seeing you. I was hoping you would say that.
lines.refusal: I am glad my company lifts you. I cannot offer everything you hope for.

lines.line: There is more I want to learn about you.
lines.reply: Ask me, then. I am beginning to trust you with more.
lines.refusal: There are things you can still learn about me. They will not change this answer.

lines.line: I would like to be part of your days.
lines.reply: I would like that. There is room for you among my ordinary days.
lines.refusal: We can be part of each other’s village days without courting.

lines.line: I hope you look forward to these visits too.
lines.reply: I do look forward to them. More than I expected at first.
lines.refusal: I welcome your visits, but I cannot welcome them as courtship.

lines.line: I thought of you on my way here.
lines.reply: What were you thinking? I like knowing I crossed your mind.
lines.refusal: I hear that you thought of me. Please listen to what I need to say.

lines.line: I am glad we are no longer strangers.
lines.reply: We have come a little way together. I am glad of it.
lines.refusal: I am glad we know each other. I do not want to repay that with a false hope.

lines.line: I am growing fond of you.
lines.reply: I am fond of you too. Let us give that feeling time to grow.
lines.refusal: Your fondness deserves an honest answer from me.

lines.line: I like the person I am getting to know.
lines.reply: I hope you will like the less polished parts of me as well.
lines.refusal: I am glad you like who I am. I must still be plain about my feelings.

lines.line: I wish our visits lasted a little longer.
lines.reply: I feel the same when it is time to part. There will be another visit.
lines.refusal: Longer visits would not make this answer kinder or different.

lines.line: There is nowhere I would rather sit just now.
lines.reply: Then sit with me. We can let the rest of the village hurry.
lines.refusal: You have chosen to sit here. I want you to know where I stand.

lines.line: I feel I can speak more freely with you.
lines.reply: You can speak freely here. I want to know what is on your mind.
lines.refusal: Speak freely, and let me do the same about my feelings.

lines.line: I saved a little of my day for you.
lines.reply: I am glad you saved it for me. I have been waiting for a quiet moment.
lines.refusal: I am grateful for the time you saved. I cannot turn it into a promise.

lines.line: Could we spend tomorrow together too?
lines.reply: I would like to see you tomorrow. Let us both have a day worth telling.
lines.refusal: Tomorrow can bring another friendly talk, but I cannot promise courtship.

lines.line: You make this place feel less lonely.
lines.reply: I know that loneliness. I am glad we can ease it for each other.
lines.refusal: I do not want loneliness to lead either of us into a false promise.

lines.line: I want us to have more days like this.
lines.reply: So do I. A life is made of days like this, after all.
lines.refusal: We can value these days together without promising a shared life.

memoryReplies.family: You remembered {name}. It means something to me that you kept that story.
memoryReplies.work: I will save you a story from the {trade} work. I like having you to tell.
memoryReplies.news: Yes, I remember telling you: {news}. It helps to talk it over with you.
memoryReplies.trait: {trait_reply} I like that you are learning who I am.

memoryRefusals.family: I am glad you listened about {name}. I need you to hear my answer as well.
memoryRefusals.trait: You have noticed my {trait} side. I must be clear about my feelings.
memoryRefusals.work: It is kind of you to take an interest in my {trade} work. I must answer honestly.
memoryRefusals.news: I did want you to hear this: {news}. Sharing news was not a promise of courtship.

lines.line: I can picture making a life beside you.
lines.reply: I can see that life too. I want us to be sure of it.
lines.refusal: I hear the life you picture. I must be honest before you build your hopes on it.

lines.line: I trust you with more than small talk now.
lines.reply: I will take care of that trust. Tell me what you have held back.
lines.refusal: I will honour your trust by speaking plainly about what I can offer.

lines.line: I want you beside me when the days are hard.
lines.reply: I want to be there when things are hard, as well as when they are easy.
lines.refusal: You deserve someone who can choose you through the hard days.

lines.line: You have become dear to me.
lines.reply: You are dear to me too. I think you know how much that means.
lines.refusal: I know I am dear to you. That makes it harder to say this, but I must.

lines.line: I would like our lives to grow together.
lines.reply: I want our lives to grow together too, without either of us disappearing.
lines.refusal: Our lives matter too much for me to promise what I cannot give.

lines.line: When I think of home, I think of you.
lines.reply: Home has begun to mean your company to me. That is something I cherish.
lines.refusal: I hear what home means to you. I cannot let you mistake my answer.

memoryReplies.family: Speaking of {name} with you feels easier now. You understand why that story matters to me.
memoryReplies.work: Some days the {trade} work leaves me worn out. I would like to come home to you then.
memoryReplies.news: I trusted you with this: {news}. You have given me no cause to regret it.
memoryReplies.trait: {trait_reply} I trust you to see that part of me clearly.

memoryRefusals.family: I am glad you listened about {name}. I need you to hear my answer as well.
memoryRefusals.trait: You have noticed my {trait} side. I must be clear about my feelings.
memoryRefusals.work: It is kind of you to take an interest in my {trade} work. I must answer honestly.
memoryRefusals.news: I did want you to hear this: {news}. Sharing news was not a promise of courtship.

lines.line: You know me better than anyone here.
lines.reply: You have stayed to learn me. I trust you with what you have found.
lines.refusal: You do know me well. Please hear this part of me too.

lines.line: I love the life we are finding together.
lines.reply: I love it too. Even the small, untidy parts of our days.
lines.refusal: The life we have found deserves an honest answer about marriage.

lines.line: I want to keep choosing you, every day.
lines.reply: And I choose you. Tomorrow will be another day to say it.
lines.refusal: Choosing each other must be something we can both do freely.

lines.line: You have my heart. I hope you know it.
lines.reply: I know, and you have mine. I do not say that lightly.
lines.refusal: I hear what you say about your heart. I will answer with care.

lines.line: I cannot imagine my days without you now.
lines.reply: My days have made a place for you that nobody else could fill.
lines.refusal: I do not want you to shape every day around a promise I cannot make.

lines.line: Whatever comes, I want to face it with you.
lines.reply: Then we will face it side by side. You need not carry it alone.
lines.refusal: Facing things together also means hearing the difficult truth.

memoryReplies.family: I want you to keep those memories of {name} with me. They belong in the life we share.
memoryReplies.work: The {trade} work is easier to face knowing you are beside me. I love that ordinary life with you.
memoryReplies.news: You stayed to listen when I told you: {news}. I love that you care about the people in my stories.
memoryReplies.trait: {trait_reply} You know that part of me, and I love that you stay.

memoryRefusals.family: I am glad you listened about {name}. I need you to hear my answer as well.
memoryRefusals.trait: You have noticed my {trait} side. I must be clear about my feelings.
memoryRefusals.work: It is kind of you to take an interest in my {trade} work. I must answer honestly.
memoryRefusals.news: I did want you to hear this: {news}. Sharing news was not a promise of courtship.

public.family: I would like to hear more about {name}.
public.work: I would like to hear about your {trade} work.
public.news: Your news about {name} stayed with me.

social.family: I remember what you told me about {name}.
social.trait: I am growing fond of your {trait} ways.
social.work: I like hearing about your work as a {trade}.
social.news: I remember the news you shared about {name}.

personal.family: Your stories of {name} make me feel closer.
personal.trait: Your {trait} side has become dear to me.
personal.work: I want to share your days, {trade} work and all.
personal.news: I am glad you trusted me with news of {name}.

intimate.family: I want to share your memories of {name}.
intimate.trait: I love you, your {trait} side and all.
intimate.work: I love sharing your days, even the {trade} work.
intimate.news: What happens to {name} matters to me too.

barriers.listener_closeness: I like your company, but I do not know you well enough to promise a life together. Let us spend more time together.
barriers.player_closeness: I feel close to you. I want you to know me just as well before we speak of marriage.
barriers.ill_will: There is still hurt between us. We need to put that right before we think of marriage.
barriers.eligibility: We cannot promise each other marriage while another commitment stands between us.

traitReplies.brave: Being brave is easier with someone worth standing beside.
traitReplies.timid: My timid ways can make a first step hard. You make it easier.
traitReplies.generous: I give what I can. I am glad my generous ways brought you closer.
traitReplies.greedy: I know I can be greedy. You need not pretend every part of me is easy.
traitReplies.proud: I am proud, yes. It matters to me that you see something to value in that.
traitReplies.humble: My humble ways do not mean I have nothing to say. I like that you listen.
traitReplies.hard-working: There is always work to do. You noticed how hard-working I am, and that means something.
traitReplies.lazy: My lazy side does like a quiet seat. I am glad you would share it.
traitReplies.cheerful: I find more to be cheerful about when you are here.
traitReplies.gloomy: You have seen my gloomy side and still come back. I value that.
traitReplies.pious: My faith shapes my pious ways. I would like you to understand it.
traitReplies.worldly: My worldly ways have given me a few stories. I would like to share them.
traitReplies.kind: I try to be kind. You make me glad of the effort.
traitReplies.cruel: You have seen my cruel side. We must speak honestly about that.
